notes.title: Patch Notes 7214_413
notes.notes:
Along with updating to Unreal Engine 5.3, the team has been working diligently on crushing bugs, improving systems, player messaging, new weapons, game balancing, and polishing. Check out our updates!

Highlights

 Cascading Hitscans
 Updating and improving AI logic
 Updated Animation System
 New and Updated VO's
 Nyx - Turret has been replaced with Blockade


Weapon Updates

 Picking up the same weapon will now have an upgrade for some weapons!


---

Ion Pistol

 Upgraded will allow you to shoot an emp upon ADS


Auto Rifle

 Upgraded will allow you to shoot a rifle grenade upon ADS


LMG

 Upgraded will give you a forward shield


Ranger

 New Weapon!


Arc Bolt

 New Weapon!


Double Barrel Shotgun

 Upgraded will give you a grappling hook upon ADS


Sidewinder

 New Weapon!


Kinetic Weapons

 Gated by Weight Type
 Nyx Healing Gun
 Skrill Minigun
 Piko Knives


Honor Blade (Melee)

 Secondary Ability - will allow you to slash through an opponent
 Upgraded allows you to dual-wield


The Mangler (Melee)

 Secondary Ability - will allow you to shoot a spike


Bot Boster

 Secondary Ability - will allow you to block


EMP

 Will disable one random ability, as well as drain Kinetic Charge and do damage to shields


SFX

 Hitscan impacts (For different weight classes)
 Impalement sounds (For different weight classes)
 Melee Attack (For different weight classes)
 Match Intro
 Character Main Menu Intro


UX/UI

 Contextual popup widget in the HUD
 Updated hit effects
 Spec descriptions
 Updated Throwdown descriptions
 Added Kinetic Cost and Cooldown descriptions for characters
 Icon Updates
 Updated UI Scaling
 Navigation Issues
 Character Selection icons now captures your character
 Scoreboard improvements
 Match Intro and End Sequence Updates
 Weapon Reward UI at the end of the match
 Updated Loading Screens


Holograms

 Paul Betraydeez & Throwdown: The Popcorn Must Flow
 Joan of Arc & Throwdown: Divine Intervention


Gamemode Additions

 Data Dash
 Free For All


Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where character skins weren't loading correctly
 Fixed an issue with profiles and frames not loading
 Fixed Play Button Options not being disabled
 Fixed loading screen text not being formatted correctly
 Fixed players not being able to spawn in after the match intro timer end
 Fixed camera sequence not stopping in the match
 Fixed AI crashing the game at the end of the match
 Fixed metrics not being sent
 Fixed Encrypted Vault Back not working on purchase
 Fixed players in parties not being able to rejoin the game upon leaving
 Fixed training missing a hud
 Fixed not being able to load the training map
 Fixed A pose in tutorial and training
 Fixed data layer issue with data dash on Zoranium Mines
 Fixed minimap colors for some players being wrong
 Fixed a potential crash with loading player data
 Fixed tutorial having Free For All team
 Fixed load renderable item sometimes not completing
 Fixed weapons not attached to players on respawn
 Fixed the grey player Zoran popup in the HUD whenever a new player joins
 Fixed VO overlap fixes
 Fixed duplicate data dash beacon fix
 Fixed previews in store for bundles

notes.title: Back to Class Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hotfix Updates
Turret 2.0

 Now properly displays in Killfeed 
 No longer softlocks tutorial
 No longer shoots friendlies


Store

 Holograms are now loading in store
 Missing Skins have been added
 Previews now load correctly
 Store loads more reliably
 Loadout Page Disappearing / Not Loading has been fixed


UI

 Character names now populate correctly in loadout selection
 Extra Play menu options now formatted correctly


Gameplay

 Zoranium Mines' bugged spawnpoint has been fixed
 Kill zones in pits now kill when you're in the zone

notes.title: Back to Class (Version B.0.0.5325_15)
notes.notes:
New System Features 
 Store legibility and functionality improvements.
 Party system improvements (You should stay on the same team when joining a match)
 Limited Daily Z-Chips to Nova Credits conversion option.
 New loading screens featuring Jive. Press to continue!
 Skins V2. You can now customize your skin per part! (Arms, legs, torso, head)
 New replay features! Capture your favorite moments!
 All players have access to hosting servers and by extension the server browser
 Milestones: One time completable challenges increases progression significantly 
New Gameplay Features 
 New ping system (Currently mapped to 7 & 8). Communicate with your team!
 New Launch Pads. Get around in style!
 New emote wheel! Hold T to choose your emote! 
New Class Features
New Classes and Abilities Released: 
 Raze 
 Adrenaline Rush: Increases damage & fire rate by 15% for 10s
 Second Wind: Increased Kinetic Charge and Health Regen
 Dodge roll 
 Nyx 
 Turret 2.0: New model and anims, more health, placed instead of thrown 
 Skrill 
 Removed charge jump (Needs reworked)
 Reworked Skrill Sprint 
 Piko 
 Invisibility: Vanishes from view, more effective when not moving. Turrets cannot target you, drops if you fire.  
New Gamemode 
 Zippin' Zchips: Race around the map to capture a rotating control point before the time runs out. Most captures wins! 
New Visual Features 
 New fullbody models for all classes.
 New holograms added to store 
 Elias Tusk
 Clark Suckerberg 
 New skins added to store 
UI / UX 
 Ingame HUD coloration adjusted for Health, Shield, and Kinetic charge
 New indicators alerting low health
 Side mouse button icon
 Titlescreen layout readjustments 
Balance Changes 
 Revamped Time to Kill: Weapons have been significantly rebalanced across the board and class' stats have been reevaluated. Each life should be more meaningful. 
Known Issues 
 Team distribution on dedicated server can be inconsistent
 Occasional UI clearing issues present in store and item descriptions
 Picking up ammunition when unarmed may cause a crash
 If you host a match and the gamemode is King of the Hill, there will be no score
 Animation errors on party members on main menu

notes.title: Hotfix B.4243_776
notes.notes:
New System Features

 Tutorial can now be entered via the pause menu
 A Message of the Day will now pop up on start

Maps

 Adjusted post process settings on Zenith Junction

UI / UX

 Default UI size reduced in preparation for a customizable UI scale setting
 Various new icons added to project

Bug Fixes

 Resolution option disabled on Windowed Fullscreen
 Adjusted explosion particle effects to be more performant
 Attachment should fade in more reliably
 End Sequence 300 v 300 bug fixed
 Loading screens and fade times adjusted
 You can no longer actively change loadouts in the same life
 Start of match performance hitch has been fixed
 Fixed not spawning with loadout when going into training
 Fixed gamepad sensitivities being zeroed out in some instances
 Lots of crash precautions and preventatives added

Known Issues

 The game can occasionally crash during the tutorial
 Audio can occasionally be inconsistent right after updates

notes.title: The Final Countdown Pt. 2 (Version A.0.0.3554_508)
notes.notes:
New System Features

 Zoranium renamed to NOVA
 Ongoing Gamepad improvements
 Premium currency can now be purchased in the store
 Account Default items have been added


New Gameplay Features

  Two new classes have been added (They currently are set to loadouts 2 & 3 respectively)

 Heavy Class: Skrill
 Light Class: Piko
 Free For All modes now do a check to respawn you farther away from other players on death
 Fully Auto Assault Rifle added
 Remote charge added
 Explosive Barrels will now appear in the environment

New Class Features
Nyx 

 Has a deployable Turret
 Has a deployable Healing Tank
 Has a Thruster for his jump
 Has a Remote Charge explosive

Skrill

 Has a Sprint that damages enemies
 Has a Charge Jump that damages enemies on landing
 Has a standard grenade

Piko

 Has Double Jump
 Has Double Dash
 Has a Proximity Mine explosive

Maps

  New Blockout Map: Sanction Labs

New Visual Features

 New assets in Sanction Labs
 New default weapon wraps

UI / UX

 New UI integration has started
 Tab menu is now sorted by most Objectives per team
 Ammo / Weapon Pickups and Objectives now show on Minimap

Balance Changes

 Sprint is now only available on Skrill
 Double Jump is now only available on Piko
 Pistol RoF reduced and damage increased
 Burst Rifle accuracy reduced while moving
 Grenade Launcher projectile bounces reduced to 1 from 2
 Grenade Launcher projectile speed significantly increased
 Grenade Launcher Projectile gravity increased
 Rocket Launcher explosion area slightly increased
 Shotgun Falloff range decreased slightly
 Maximum Ammo size increased for all ammo types

Bug Fixes

 Stuttering no longer happens in Spectator Cam
 Game no longer crashes leaving Zoranium Mine
 Long Range Throwdowns have been renamed
 Control Point Audio has been fixed
 Minimap Icons now stay in a fixed position
 Party widget will now properly hide when going in and out of other menus
 There is now a text indicator that a player in your part is ready rather than just dancing
 Party Ready option should now populate correctly
 Clients now get the Countdown as expected
 Quickplay now behaves as expected


Known Issues

 Parties will join a match, but will be distributed among the teams equally
 Host doesn’t have a kill feed on listen server

notes.title: The Final Countdown (Version A.0.0.3097_442)
notes.notes:
New System Features

 Daily Challenges
 In Match Music Player
 Achievements
 Per weapon stats tracked for each weapon
 Gamepad Support has been completely revamped
 Dev tags have been added. Now you'll know when we're playing too!


New Gamemode

 Gun game added


New Gameplay Features

 Characters can be knocked down from abilities and some weapon related explosions
 Cannonball long range throwdown


New Visual Features

 Shift toward new stylistic direction
 Big X and Mr. Likeable have updated models
 Multiple new skins and accessories available in Store
 Levels now start with an animated camera preview
 Other players in the party now dance to signify they're "Ready"


Maps

 Zoranium Mines has been finalized
 Large Cognition Floor added


UI / UX

 Store is now accessible and items can be purchased for Z-Chips


New Audio Features

 Sound cutting issues have been fixed


Balance Changes

 Sniper firing rate reduced, magazine reduced to two, damage reversed to previous values
 SMG damage increased, Fire rate reduced,  now deals non modified damage ( Headshots and body shots do the same damage), Lowered magazine capacity
 Grenade and Rocket launcher projectiles speed increased
 Rocket launcher starts with more ammo
 Grenade launcher firing rate reduced
 Max player cap has been changed to 16
 Grenades are now less bouncy and behave more realistically


Bug Fixes

 Close range throwdown system reworked, characters now align properly
 You can no longer jump when getting throwdowned
 Performance degradation fixed
 Random freeze should be fixed
 Party system and invites should behave as expected


Known Issues

 Training area needs overhauled (It's been removed from the experience till then)
 Post processing can be inconsistent across maps
 Not all maps recognize the shift in art direction yet
 Gamepad issues persist but are highly prioritized for next update
 Weapon names may not populate correctly when playing on Linux through Proton
 Weapon pickup notifications are inconsistent


As always thanks to all of the users who provided feedback and helped us test out!

notes.title: Minor Patch Update August 16th (Version A.0.0.166)
notes.notes:
New System Features
- Store is now active! (Your inventory will start empty, but there are lots of free skins available!)

New Gameplay Features
- New soft lock for Melee Weapon (While using a melee weapon your camera will automatically track your target)

New Visual Features
- New effects added when the Overclock state engages
- Camera now spectates killer on death (Let us know what you think!)
- New Attachments
- New Skins
- Melee weapons now has visual effects for impact
- Melee weapons now have an effect associated with their passive (Lifesteal / Shield Stacking)
- Sniper has more visual flare when firing

UI / UX
- Quit match option added at round end
- MVP is now displayed for objective based gamemodes at round end
- Store has been redesigned

New Audio Features
-New Sound FX queues added to control points and throwdowns

Maps
- New assets added to The Hall V2

New Holograms
- Lady Fawkes
- Nash
- Some Holograms have multiple outfits! Press on them again to see.

New Close Range Throwdowns
- Mr. Likeable

Balance Changes
- Melee has been rebalanced significantly
- Stagger is no longer as punishing (Looking at you, melee)
- Energy Beam (throwdown) aiming sensitivity increased

Bug Fixes
- Training area is now working
- Weapon orientation issues for Throwdowns have been resolved
- Performance degradation issues may be resolved (Needs further testing)
- Hitch on Weapon Swap may be resolved (Needs further testing)

Known Issues
- Occasionally the loadout select screen will persist on spawn
- Game mode roulette is currently not working
- Occasionally leaving a match will sometimes make you unable to join a new one without restart
- Spectator cam can have some jitter
- AI can spawn in A poses (This issue resolves itself on respawn)
- Bullets can pass through the roof of Temple and Shrine on Hall V2
- End of match sequence can cause issues
- Sometimes cosmetic changes aren't reflected in game from the title screen
- Equipment screen is a little cluttered

notes.title: Everything's Under Control Update August 2nd (Version A.0.0.151)
notes.notes:

The Control Point game mode has been added and is available on TheHall_V2 and Zenith Junction

New System Features
Dedicated servers (Will be enabled for special events)

New Gameplay Features
Knockback and stagger added
Ammo pickups added and Weapon pickups reduced
General map adjustments for balancing

Throwdowns
Kill streaks activate "Overclock" state (Enables the use of throwdowns -> "F" and "G" keys)
Close range and long range throwdowns added

New Close Range Throwdowns
GetVerified2.0
Z - Kick

New Long Range Throwdowns
Energy Blast
Energy Beam

New Visual Features
New screen effects when damage is taken
New screen effects on death
Chasebar for Health
Random animation plays when triggering hologram

Maps
New assets added to The Hall V2
Train added to Zenith Junction

UI / UX
New global leaderboard for kills
Friend panel updates and fixes
Party system

New Audio Features
General
New music added
New sound FX added to Throwdowns

Balance Changes
Proximity mine timer reduced in half
Sniper firing rate reduced

Bug Fixes
Re-fixed incorrect weapon animations on spawn
Melee improvement to make hits more reliable
Login flow reworked (Steam now functions correctly)
Neon is now correctly appearing on the Main Menu loadout
Character rotation improved on Main Menu
Music can now properly be paused on the Main Menu

As always thanks to all of the users who provided feedback and helped us test out!

notes.title: Bugfix / Feature Update Patch A.0.0.76
notes.notes:
New Features
Performance and Graphics Enhancements
Performance improvements
Environmental lighting improvements
Reworked Match Start up Sequence

AI Bot Updates
AI is now smarter

Sound Design Improvements
Redesigned sound effects for most weapons
Remixed overall sound levels

Gameplay Additions
Map roulette
New melee combo animation
New Aerial Attack and Charge Dash
Aerial Attack and Charge dash have been redesigned
New Animation and VFX for Double Jump (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)

Map Changes
Updated Cognition Floor with new assets
Introduced new team spawn zones with team colored gates
Training Map HDRI

Bug Fixes
Bots move more accurately
Warm up spawns now on every map
You can no longer cancel reload animations (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)
Aerial Attack no longer leaves the reticle behind (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)
Joining audio no longer loops for every player in match
Quickplay made sessions can now reliably be joined
Boundary breaks are no longer possible on Zenith Junction (Thanks Quixotic!)
On first spawn clients will no long experience rubber banding (Thanks Erick!)
Scoreboard no longer jitters when spamming TAB
Graphics are more consistent across quality levels
Menus should no longer be able to get stuck on screen
Crashing on map transition has been fixed
Team / Enemy Fresnel is loading correctly (Thanks Ushio!)
Stairs and random collisions have been fixed in the Training Area (Thanks Quixotic!)
Skill icons no longer show up all as grenade
Immunity on Spawn has been added (Thanks Enadream!)
Damage numbers are now rounded
Charge Dash now displays properly in kill feed

Balance Patch
SMG Damage per Shot 7 -> 6
SMG Rate of Fire 800 -> 700
All guns have new upper ammo caps (Thanks AdeptMasterN8!)


 Light Weapons (Pistol, Nano Swarm)
 120

 90
 Shotgun

 8

Charge Dash / Aerial possible desync

Sometimes spawn using pistol animations regardless of weapon
You can shoot through walls if you're too close to them

Special thanks to all of the users who helped us find these bugs! This wouldn't be possible without you playing and being excellent members of the Zorans community.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch - A.0.0.71
notes.notes:
- Nameplates and outlines for players should now display properly on first spawn.
- Player / Bot join messages should now have team colors if assigned on non-host clients.
- Slightly increased the accuracy on pistol / reduced spread from movement.
- Halved time between shots for Burst Rifle.
- Tab Scoreboard in game should now update properly for non-host clients.
- Grenade (Q) has slightly less bounce and a bit more gravity.
- Explosions (Grenades / Rockets) were not registering all hits properly, this is now fixed!
